headline.en: UNI at $3.97 remains net inflationary despite fee switch; retail crowded long with no v4 fee catalyst yet priced.
headline.zh: UNI 现价 $3.97 仍处净通胀,散户多头拥挤,v4 手续费催化剂尚未被市场定价。

keyChanges.en: Net emission still positive at +1.61%/year — $15.39M annualized buyback burns only 3.88M UNI against 20M annual emission.
keyChanges.zh: 净发行率仍为 +1.61%/年 —— $15.39M 年化 buyback 仅销毁 3.88M UNI,不及 20M 年度增发。

keyChanges.en: L/S ratio 2.19 with funding at +0.01% signals retail-long overhang, not institutional accumulation; $20.29M OI is thin.
keyChanges.zh: 多空比 2.19、funding 仅 +0.01%,是典型散户单边多头堆积而非机构建仓;$20.29M OI 盘口偏薄。

keyChanges.en: Two live temp checks (v4 protocol fees + Robinhood Chain fee expansion) could reshape buyback math but remain unpriced.
keyChanges.zh: 两项 temp check(v4 协议费 + Robinhood Chain 手续费扩张)可能重构 buyback 模型,但市场尚未计价。

contrarianObservation.en: If the v4 fee temp check advances to an on-chain vote in Q4, annualized revenue could jump 30-50% and flip net emission negative without any price move. The market is pricing near-zero probability of governance execution; at $3.97 the option-value on that catalyst is asymmetrically cheap.
contrarianObservation.zh: 若 v4 协议费 temp check 在 Q4 推进至链上投票,协议收入有望增长 30-50%,在币价不动的前提下即可翻转为净通缩。当前市场对此几乎零定价,$3.97 位置上的这一治理期权价值呈非对称便宜。

watchNext.en: v4 Protocol Fees temp check — whether it advances to Snapshot and then on-chain vote.
watchNext.zh: v4 协议费 temp check —— 是否推进至 Snapshot 与链上投票阶段。

watchNext.en: Robinhood Chain fee expansion progression and any incremental revenue guidance from the Foundation.
watchNext.zh: Robinhood Chain 手续费扩张的推进节奏,以及基金会披露的增量收入指引。

watchNext.en: Emergence of any real-yield / staking RFC — the single regime-defining variable, currently absent from top forum threads.
watchNext.zh: real-yield / staking 相关 RFC 是否出现 —— 决定 UNI 估值范式的核心变量,当前论坛热帖中缺位。

fullReasoning.en: UNI at $3.97 sits 33% below the DAO's own $5.96 burn anchor — the market explicitly disagrees with governance's fair-value mark. The core problem is arithmetic: at $90.53M annualized revenue, the 17% buyback line consumes just $15.39M, burning 3.88M UNI against 20M annual emissions, so net supply still grows +1.61%/year. The 'burn narrative' is mathematically broken at current revenue, and price appreciation makes it worse, not better — higher UNI means fewer coins burned per dollar. Positioning confirms weakness: L/S 2.19 with funding barely positive is textbook retail-long overhang, and $20.29M OI is thin enough that any real seller dominates tape. Unichain at $27.63M TVL is a rounding error against $3.06B mainnet — the L2 thesis is not materializing at scale. What could rescue this thesis are the two live temp checks on v4 protocol fees and Robinhood Chain fee expansion; either would materially change revenue economics. But Uniswap governance moves at glacial pace and neither is close to on-chain vote, while the regime-defining question — routing buybacks to stakers as real yield — is entirely absent from top forum threads today. Bearish 1-4 weeks. v4 temp check outcome is the swing factor. Below $3.50 becomes accumulation zone; a push above $4.50 without a governance catalyst is a fade.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 现价 $3.97,较 DAO 自身设定的 $5.96 burn 锚定价低 33% —— 市场明确否认了治理层给出的'公允价值'标尺。核心问题是算术:年化协议收入 $90.53M,17% 的 buyback 预算仅 $15.39M,销毁 3.88M UNI,对比每年 20M 增发,净发行率仍为 +1.61%/年。'销毁叙事'在当前收入水平下并不成立,且币价越涨、每美元回购的 UNI 越少,这一问题无法通过价格上涨自愈。仓位结构印证疲弱:多空比 2.19、funding 仅 +0.01%,是典型散户单边多头堆积,而非机构建仓;$20.29M OI 极薄,任何真实卖压都可主导盘面。Unichain 仅 $27.63M TVL,相对主网 $3.06B 几乎可以忽略 —— L2 叙事未能兑现。可能扭转局面的变量是当前两项 temp check:v4 协议费与 Robinhood Chain 手续费扩张,任一激活都将实质性改变收入模型。但 Uniswap 治理历史推进极慢,两者均远未进入链上投票阶段;真正决定估值范式的问题 —— buyback 是否最终以 real yield 形式分给 stakers —— 在今日热帖中完全缺位。1-4 周维度看空。v4 temp check 走向是关键摆动因子。$3.50 下方进入吸筹区;若无治理催化剂却上冲 $4.50,则是做空点。
